steps.question: What does the word ‘Bhil’ stand for?
steps.modelAnswer: The word ‘Bhil’ is believed to come from the Dravidian word ‘bil’, meaning bow, which is their characteristic weapon.

modelMeaning.hi: माना जाता है कि ‘भील’ शब्द द्रविड़ शब्द ‘बिल’ (धनुष) से बना है, जो उनका ख़ास हथियार है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Maana jaata hai ki ‘Bhil’ shabd Dravid shabd ‘bil’ (dhanush) se bana hai, jo unka khaas hathiyaar hai.

steps.question: Name the tribal-rich areas of M.P.
options: Jhabua, Dhar, Khargone, Barwani and Ratlam
steps.answer: Jhabua, Dhar, Khargone, Barwani and Ratlam
steps.modelAnswer: The tribal-rich areas of M.P. are mainly Jhabua, Dhar, Khargone, Barwani and Ratlam districts.

modelMeaning.hi: म.प्र. के आदिवासी बहुल इलाक़े मुख्य रूप से झाबुआ, धार, खरगोन, बड़वानी और रतलाम ज़िले हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: M.P. ke aadivaasi bahul ilaake mukhya roop se Jhabua, Dhaar, Khargone, Badwaani aur Ratlaam zile hain.

steps.question: What is ‘Gatla’?
steps.modelAnswer: A Gatla is a stone-carved and oil-painted memory pillar. The Bhils erect it in memory of a family member who met with an unnatural death.

modelMeaning.hi: गाटला पत्थर पर नक़्क़ाशी किया और तेल रंग से रंगा स्मृति स्तंभ है। भील इसे अचानक मरे परिवार के सदस्य की याद में खड़ा करते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gatla patthar par nakkaashi kiya aur tel rang se ranga smriti stambh hai. Bhil ise achaanak mare parivaar ke sadasya ki yaad mein khada karte hain.

steps.question: What kind of dresses do Bhil women wear?

questionMeaning.hi: भील औरतें कैसे कपड़े पहनती हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhil auratein kaise kapde pehenti hain?

options: colourful ghaghara with polka and kanchali
steps.answer: colourful ghaghara with polka and kanchali
steps.modelAnswer: Bhil women wear colourful ghaghara with polka, kanchali and so on.

modelMeaning.hi: भील औरतें रंग-बिरंगा घाघरा, पोलका, कांचली आदि पहनती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhil auratein rang-biranga ghaaghra, polka, kaanchli aadi pehenti hain.

steps.question: What are the important dance forms of the Bhils?
options: Solo, Lahari, Pali, Dandavadi, Ghodo, Dang Solo and Chalavadi
steps.answer: Solo, Lahari, Pali, Dandavadi, Ghodo, Dang Solo and Chalavadi

steps.question: Name tribal personalities with international recognition.

questionMeaning.hi: विश्व में पहचाने गए आदिवासी कलाकार
questionMeaning.hinglish: Vishva mein pehchaane gaye aadivaasi kalaakaar

options: Pema Fatya, Ram Singh Urveti and Teejan Bai
steps.answer: Pema Fatya, Ram Singh Urveti and Teejan Bai
steps.modelAnswer: Pema Fatya (Bhil artist), Ram Singh Urveti (Gond artist) and Teejan Bai (Pandvani singer) have got international recognition.

modelMeaning.hi: पेमा फत्या (भील कलाकार), राम सिंह उर्वेती (गोंड कलाकार) और तीजन बाई (पंडवानी गायिका) को अंतरराष्ट्रीय पहचान मिली है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pema Fatya (Bhil kalaakaar), Ram Singh Urveti (Gond kalaakaar) aur Teejan Bai (Pandvani gaayika) ko antarraashtriya pehchaan mili hai.

steps.question: What is the Bhagoria Haat?
options: a weekly market a week before Holi, celebrated with dance and gulal
steps.answer: a weekly market a week before Holi, celebrated with dance and gulal
steps.modelAnswer: The weekly market held a week before Holi is celebrated as Bhagoria. People dance, apply gulal on the faces of relatives and friends, and offer sweets, snacks and ice-candies. Children enjoy rides on swings.

modelMeaning.hi: होली से एक हफ़्ते पहले लगने वाला साप्ताहिक हाट भगोरिया के रूप में मनाया जाता है। लोग नाचते हैं, रिश्तेदारों-दोस्तों को गुलाल लगाते हैं, मिठाई और नाश्ता खिलाते हैं। बच्चे झूलों का मज़ा लेते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Holi se ek hafte pehle lagne waala saaptaahik haat Bhagoria ke roop mein manaaya jaata hai. Log naachte hain, rishtedaaron-doston ko gulaal lagaate hain, mithaai aur naashta khilaate hain. Bachche jhoolon ka maza lete hain.

text.hi: (B) Yes या No में जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: (B) Yes ya No mein jawab do.

steps.question: Do the Bhils live in pucca houses?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या भील पक्के घरों में रहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Bhil pakke gharon mein rehte hain?

options: No, mostly in wood and bamboo houses.
steps.answer: No, mostly in wood and bamboo houses.
steps.modelAnswer: No. Their houses are mainly made of wood and bamboo with tiled roofs, though some people build pucca and semi-pucca houses.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं। उनके घर मुख्य रूप से लकड़ी और बाँस के, खपरैल की छत वाले होते हैं; हालाँकि कुछ लोग पक्के घर भी बनाते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi. Unke ghar mukhya roop se lakdi aur baans ke, khapraal ki chhat waale hote hain; haalaanki kuchh log pakke ghar bhi banaate hain.

steps.question: Are they fond of tattooing?
steps.modelAnswer: Yes. Tattooing, called ‘Godana’, is customary among them.

modelMeaning.hi: हाँ। गोदना उनमें एक रिवाज़ है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haan. Godna unmein ek rivaaz hai.

steps.question: Are the Bhils proficient in stone craft?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या भील पत्थर की कारीगरी में माहिर हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Bhil patthar ki kaarigari mein maahir hain?

steps.modelAnswer: Yes. They carve stone memory pillars called Gatla.

modelMeaning.hi: हाँ। वे पत्थर के गाटला स्तंभ तराशते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Haan. Woh patthar ke Gatla stambh taraashte hain.

steps.question: Is Teejan Bai famous for singing Pandvani?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या तीजन बाई पंडवानी के लिए मशहूर हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Teejan Bai Pandvani ke liye mashhoor hain?

steps.question: Do the Bhils like colourful dresses?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या भीलों को रंग-बिरंगे कपड़े पसंद हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Bheelon ko rang-birange kapde pasand hain?
